response.sql: WITH matched_fees AS (SELECT o.mktnote, f.feerate - f.rebrate AS net_fee_rate FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON CAST(o.recordvault AS TEXT) = CAST(f.orderslink AS TEXT)), overall AS (SELECT AVG(net_fee_rate) AS avg_net_fee_rate FROM matched_fees), pair_rates AS (SELECT mktnote, AVG(net_fee_rate) AS avg_net_fee_rate FROM matched_fees GROUP BY mktnote) SELECT AVG(p.avg_net_fee_rate) AS mean_pair_net_fee_rate, AVG(p.avg_net_fee_rate - a.avg_net_fee_rate) AS mean_excess_net_fee_rate FROM pair_rates AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS a WHERE p.avg_net_fee_rate > a.avg_net_fee_rate;
